sourcePolicy: Completed quest status and IDs are authoritative only when present in the verified EU Blizzard profile. Quest briefing excerpts come from Blizzard static-forever-eu. Objective summaries below are editorial paraphrases of the official briefing and/or prior player screenshots, not a server-side objective checklist. Exact completion dates and rewards are not inferred. Episodes are original roleplay fiction inspired by verified quest names and context, not records of actual gameplay. General assignment summaries are paraphrases of quest context and are not the exact in-game objective checklist.

episodes.title: What Echo Ridge Did Not Tell
episodes.subtitle: An expedition beneath the mountain
episodes.teaser: The kobolds called the mine their home. The priest heard something different in the noise of the picks: a warning that the mountain had been opened too deeply.

episodes.title: The Harvest the Thieves Could Not Keep
episodes.subtitle: Northshire Vineyards
episodes.teaser: A woman who had planted grapes was left to bargain with men who had never planted anything. Xuthar could not rescue the summer, but he could save the record of its harvest.

episodes.title: Candles for a Distant Window
episodes.subtitle: From Elwynn to the canals of Stormwind
episodes.teaser: Between the forest and the great city a box of humble candles passed from one pair of hands to another. Not every precious light burns in a chapel.

episodes.title: The Light That Did Not Demand Belief
episodes.subtitle: A priest's trial
episodes.teaser: The Light asked for a simple gesture, not a declaration. Xuthar discovered that compassion might outlive certainty.

episodes.title: An Unseen Road Between Two Houses
episodes.subtitle: Elwynn's separated lovers
episodes.teaser: Two households had turned affection into a feud. A borrowed bottle of invisibility did not mend their bitterness, but it could keep a meeting possible.

episodes.title: What the River Refused to Return
episodes.subtitle: The Crystal Lake errands
episodes.teaser: The lake yielded half-eaten fish, broken trinkets and strange ingredients. Every object was evidence that the water had kept someone else's story.

episodes.title: The Incinerator’s Broken Promise
episodes.subtitle: Fire and stolen steel
episodes.teaser: Gar’im’s cave and the camps below Stonewatch are parts of the same tightening fist. Two companions return to loosen its hold.

episodes.title: The Name Beneath the Last Defeat
episodes.subtitle: Stonewatch answered
episodes.teaser: The fortress remembers Xuthar’s earlier failure. Beside Carro, he returns to give the unfinished name another ending.

episodes.title: A Shadow Answered by Its Witness
episodes.subtitle: The Lion and the Warlock
episodes.teaser: From the Old Lion Statue to Ilgalar’s shadowed chamber, Theocritus’ inquiry reaches its dangerous answer.

episodes.title: Forgive My Slow Pace
episodes.subtitle: No one left in the dark
episodes.teaser: After the Blackrock Champions, a wounded soldier asks for help. The greatest victory will be measured one careful footstep at a time.

episodes.title: Let the Living Have the View
episodes.subtitle: The people behind the promises
episodes.teaser: Food for a hungry township and the fear carried by a distant howl: the quiet obligations belong beside great battles. Solomon's unfinished letter would receive its answer on 20 November.

episodes.title: Two Towns, No Army
episodes.subtitle: Messenger to Darkshire · Parts 1 and 2
episodes.teaser: Solomon asks for Darkshire's Night Watch. Ebonlocke cannot abandon his own people. Xuthar carries both a plea and a refusal, finding the cost of protection in two towns left to stand alone.
episodes.sourceNote: Both IDs newly completed in the 20 Nov 20:21 Italy official Blizzard snapshot; literary dialogue, timing and atmosphere are fictional.

episodes.title: Stonewatch Triumph
episodes.subtitle: The Orbs, the Orc and the Lakefire
episodes.teaser: With Carro Steelcave at his side, Xuthar recovers the Midnight Orbs and defeats Tharil'zun. The night ends beside a lakeside bonfire with friends.
episodes.sourceNote: Xuthar confirmed both quest completions, now independently verified by Blizzard EU Forever at 22:01 Italian time on 20 November 2026; 247 completed quest IDs and six active. Seven original Full HD screenshots and a separately labelled commemorative illustration.

episodes.title: Where the Lanterns Hold
episodes.subtitle: Duskwood · The Adventure Begins
episodes.teaser: Xuthar returns to the town that could not spare an army. The first Stalvan errand is complete, while eleven new commissions open the roads of Duskwood.
episodes.sourceNote: Darkshire arrival announced by Xuthar with original Full HD screenshot. Official API verifies introductory Stalvan #66 complete and next stage #67 active. Novel scenes and personal motivation are roleplay.

episodes.title: The Hermit at the Door
episodes.subtitle: Duskwood · Level 25
episodes.teaser: Abercrombie is found, but his supply request now points to Madame Eva and a spectral comb for Blind Mary.
episodes.sourceNote: Verified completions newly observed since the 21 November arrival snapshot; the interval spans late 21 and 22 November. Precise hand-in times are not provided.

episodes.title: The History Returned
episodes.subtitle: Duskwood · Level 25
episodes.teaser: The Raven Hill Tome restores part of a forgotten family’s history. Ira’s dagger still carries an unfinished duty.
episodes.sourceNote: Verified completions newly observed since the 21 November arrival snapshot; the interval spans late 21 and 22 November. Precise hand-in times are not provided.

episodes.title: The Camp at the Western Edge
episodes.subtitle: Duskwood · Level 25
episodes.teaser: Supplies reach Sven and Lars, and their wolf hunt is complete. Sven’s loss opens a new investigation at the old farm.
episodes.sourceNote: Verified completions newly observed since the 21 November arrival snapshot; the interval spans late 21 and 22 November. Precise hand-in times are not provided.

episodes.title: A Meal Before Another Mystery
episodes.subtitle: Duskwood · Level 25
episodes.teaser: Jitters is found and Grual’s kitchen work is finished. The cakes are still waiting to be delivered.
